scope: Drill the FUN_0058B2A0 sub-dispatcher (BCS-Y-0617 ThirdRouter_Case0xCE_ActionAnimationSubDispatcher, 442 bytes). This is the handler for third-router (FUN_0058CCA0 CharaElement::vftable[9]) case 0xCE. Enumerate the per-case downstream chain to attribute the full chara-action-state pipeline.

method.step1: Decomp FUN_0058B2A0 (already cataloged as BCS-Y-0617). Confirms 442B structure: 20-way switch on param_5 (sub-opcode 1..0x18) all forwarding to FUN_0058ADC0; default branch writes position state at +0xB0/+0xB8.
method.step2: Bulk-decomp the 4 key callees (FUN_0058ADC0 + FUN_0058A090 + FUN_005878A0 + FUN_005886B0) to characterize the action-state pipeline downstream of the dispatcher.
method.step3: Cross-reference s2c 0x00CE Pattern B gap (the pcap opcode coverage matrix pass rank 4, 239 pcap hits). Confirms 0x00CE = action-state-change packet carrier - the chain from FUN_0058CCA0 case 0xCE through FUN_0058B2A0 sub-dispatch to FUN_0058ADC0 state setter is now fully traceable.

key_findings: FUN_0058ADC0 (270B) is the universal CharaActionStateSetter - called for ALL 20 sub-states (1..10 + 0xF..0x18) by FUN_0058B2A0. Sets sentinel byte +0xEB (default 10, 0x3c for state 0x17), updates state bits at +0xE8, then EITHER (if previous state +0xE6 == 1) writes only position params and returns OR (otherwise) commits new state via FUN_0058A7F0, clears 6 low state bits, writes new state at +0xE4 + position params at +0xC0..+0xD8 + sub-flag at +0xE6. This IS the actor state-machine state-write boundary.

FUN_0058A090 (1784B) is the CharaActionStateTickProcessor - HUGE state machine run each frame. Outer switch on actor's current action state (+0xE4 set by FUN_0058ADC0) covers the same 20 cases 1..10 + 0xF..0x18. Inner switch on a 5-bit sub-state derived from +0xE8 covers 16 cases 0..0xF - each is a specific tick phase. CRITICAL crosslinks: calls FUN_00589030 (BCS-Y-0328 c2s 0x00CA UpdatePlayerPosition stack-record path), FUN_00586F40 / FUN_00586FB0 (BCS-Y-0330 c2s 0x0007 ZoneInComplete emitter pair), FUN_005878A0 (position snapshot), 6+ FUN_004D7xxx state-update helpers. 2 callers: FUN_0058DF90 (TBD) + FUN_0058B2A0 dispatcher. THIS IS THE LINK between server-pushed action-state changes (s2c 0x00CE) and outbound position-update emit (c2s 0x00CA).

FUN_005878A0 (529B) is the CharaPositionOrientationSnapshot serializer. Reads target position (+0xC0/+0xC8) and rotation (+0xE0) set by FUN_0058ADC0, normalizes rotation to [-PI, PI], snapshots last-sent fields at +0x9C/+0xA4/+0xAC/+0xB0/+0xB8, broadcasts 3 state events via FUN_004D7980 with subtypes 0x24/0x25/0x26 (position/heading/derived). Sets snapshot-taken flag bit 2 at +0x274. 2 callers: FUN_0058B2A0 (when state == 1) + FUN_0058A090 (tick processor).

FUN_005886B0 (427B) is the CharaPositionHistoryRingBuffer (64-entry x 16-byte position records at +0x00..+0x3FF). Has self-recursive one-time-init that clears all 64 entries. Computes Euclidean distance between latest and previous position; only advances ring head if distance > threshold or forced. Maintains exponential moving average at +0x404 (probably for animation smoothing or motion prediction). 4 callers including FUN_0058B2A0.

PATTERN B CLOSURE for s2c 0x00CE: this pipeline closes the pcap opcode coverage matrix pass's rank 4 actor-cluster gap (239 hits). 0x00CE carries action-state changes for actors: zone-state dispatcher FUN_004DC690 case 0xCE -> actor vftable[9] -> CharaElement::vftable[9] (FUN_0058CCA0) -> third-router case 0xCE -> [[ThirdRouter_Case0xCE_ActionAnimationSubDispatcher_FUN_0058B2A0]] (BCS-Y-0617) -> [[CharaActionStateSetter_FUN_0058ADC0]] (here) for the 20 cataloged sub-states or default position-write. The downstream tick processor FUN_0058A090 then ALSO emits c2s 0x00CA UpdatePlayerPosition - this is the s2c-to-c2s feedback loop where receiving a server position update triggers an immediate client-side position acknowledgment.

Architectural significance: confirms s2c-to-c2s feedback loop in actor state. FUN_0058A090's emit of c2s 0x00CA (via BCS-Y-0328) during the tick processor explains why c2s 0x00CA is the HEAVIEST c2s opcode (16871 pcap hits) - every s2c 0x00CE actor-state change triggers a c2s position emit. The frequency ratio matches: c2s 0x00CA (16871) is ~70x higher than s2c 0x00CE (239), consistent with the tick processor running each frame for the duration the actor is in a given state.
